    The tracial matrix ultrapower, concretely (D2 relocation) #

    TracialMatrixUltrapower, TracePreservingUltrapowerEmbedding, and ConnesEmbeddable, relocated here (downstream of the concrete tracial-ultraproduct C*-algebra) so the ultrapower carrier Rω comes with a trace-preserving ⋆ₐ-iso concrete_model : Rω ≃⋆ₐ[ℂ] MatrixSeqQuotient dim ω σ. The old Basic.lean version tied Rω only to the structureless Filter.Germ carrier, which supplied no representatives or algebraic relations; the concrete model is what makes microstate extraction possible (sharpening ConnesEmbeddable to the faithful "embeds into the matrix ultraproduct" notion — a C30 fidelity gain).

    A bundled tracial matrix ultrapower: a C*-algebra Rω with a trace-preserving ⋆ₐ-iso to the concrete tracial-ultraproduct C*-algebra MatrixSeqQuotient.
